book.name: Pilipai
book.title: Pilipai Pol Pilipai nɨbi bɨ kalɨp köp kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka

content: Krais nɨp nɨŋ udpin u me, God yɨp nɨŋöm bɨ kamɨŋ aij yad hagöp

Añ mam bɨ. Yad manö söl hag junɨg gem, kalöp manö ap halö hagnɨg gabin. Bɨ Kub nɨbi bɨ nɨpe mɨdpim rö, mɨñ mɨñ gɨmim. Manö kalöp nöd hagnö u, kauyaŋ hagnam a gɨnö, yɨp marö gagöp. Kauyaŋ hagnö mɨd aij geinabim u aij.
Kain hauƚ gau nɨŋ aij göl gɨ mɨdaimim. Kale nan naij yabɨƚ gɨpal. Kale hañ romaŋ rɨb gɨ dö gɨpal.

Hon me God nɨbi bɨ nɨpe yɨjɨg göl mɨdpun. Nɨhön gɨnɨg: God Ana nɨpe u hanɨp aip mɨdö, God nɨp sabe gun. Krais Jisas nɨp cɨg gun aij a gö nɨŋöl gɨ mɨdpun u me, God nɨbi bɨ nɨpe yɨjɨg göl mɨdpun. Hon hañ romaŋ nan gau gɨpal gasɨ nɨŋun God nɨbi bɨ nɨpe mɨdageinabun, a gɨ gasɨ nɨŋbun u me, God nɨbi bɨ nɨpe kabö göl mɨdpun.
Pen hañ romaŋ nan gau gɨpal manö u hagöm, hon bɨ kub mɨdpun a gɨnaböl u, yad hagnabin, kale hañ romaŋ nan anɨb gau bɨ kub wasö, yad ke nöp bɨ kub mɨdpin.

Yɨp yag dapöm ñɨn unbö raleb u mɨdöm, waŋ hañ u rɨb gɨ dö gɨla. Bac iƚaŋ hon Isrel, ñɨ nɨpe hain Benjamin iƚ u me, yad bɨ Hibru yɨjɨg göl mɨdpin. Pen Juda lo manö hagpal u, yad bɨ Perisi mɨdainö rö, manö anɨbu hagöp rö magöŋhalö nɨŋ aij gem gɨ mɨdmɨdin.
Juda manö anɨbu nɨŋ damem kƚö yabɨƚ juem, Krais nɨbi bɨ kalɨp nɨŋem, gɨ naij yabɨƚ gɨmɨdin. Hon Juda nɨbi bɨ lo manö pro pro ke ke gau gɨmɨdin rö, bɨ kub gau yɨp manö ap hagöl rö laga.

Pen hainö gasɨ nɨŋ aij gem, nöd gɨmɨdin adö anɨbu nɨŋ aij gem gagmɨdin u nɨŋem, Krais yɨp göp u nöp nan aij a gɨ gasɨ añɨ u nöp nɨŋöl gem, nöd gɨmɨdin nan gau magöŋhalö nan yɨharɨŋ rö böŋ nöp arö gɨnö.

Pen nöd gɨmɨdin nan gau nöp wasö. Gasɨ yad nɨŋbin u, Krais Jisas Bɨ Kub yad nɨŋbin u nan kub yabɨƚ. Nan rɨmnap gau magöŋhalö nan yɨharɨŋ yabɨƚ. Krais Jisas nɨp wög gɨnam a gem, nan gau magöŋhalö arö gɨnö. Krais bɨ nɨpe mɨdem, nɨp nɨŋ aij gɨnam a gem, nan gau magöŋhalö acɨp acɨp rö nɨŋbin.
Yad Krais aip jɨm ñöl nöp mɨdeinam. Yad Juda lo manö adö u geinabin u, God yɨp nɨŋöm bɨ kamɨŋ aij yad hagagnab. Pen Krais nɨp nɨŋ udpin u me, God yɨp nɨŋöm bɨ kamɨŋ aij yad hagöp.
Anɨb u, Krais nɨp nɨŋ aij gem, nɨpe uraka u kƚö anɨbu nɨŋem, nɨpe marö kub uda u rö marö udem, nɨpe uma u rö umem,
nɨpe uraka u rö God gö yad u rö nöp uraknabin.
Pol kƚö göm ga
Yad nan hagajɨn anɨbi magöŋhalö udem bɨ asɨŋ mɨdagöp mɨdpin u hagagabin. Pen Krais Jisas yɨp udö bɨ aigeg bɨ rö mɨdeinabin a göm ga u rö udnam a gem, kƚö gem dip arabin.
Añ mam bɨ. Nan aij anɨbu hadö udpin a gem hagagabin. Pen yad gasɨ añɨ ap mɨdöp. Nöd gɨmɨdin u hauƚ gem, le löm nan aij adan au nɨŋem dip arabin.

God nan aij yɨp ñɨnab u udnam a gɨ gasɨ añɨ u nöp nɨŋöl gem, adan au kabö rö nöp gɨ dö gɨ amem, res pɨs gɨnab nagɨ anɨbu dip arabin. God yɨp wɨñ alöm nan aij ñɨnab u, Krais Jisas yɨp gö ram mɨnöŋ kumi kabö adö laŋ au pör mɨdeinabin.
Hon nɨbi bɨ God nɨp cɨg aij gɨ mɨdpun gau magöŋhalö, gasɨ anɨbu rö nöp nɨŋun. Pen manö adö rɨmnap gasɨ ke nɨŋeinabim u, God kalöp gasɨ yɨjɨg göl nɨŋeb u yamnab.
Pen Krais manö aij nɨŋ udpun u arö gagun; manö anɨbu nɨŋ aij göl gɨ gɨno arnɨm.
Añ mam bɨ. Yad gɨpin rö gɨ dammim, nɨbi bɨ anɨb rö gɨlö aröp gau nɨŋmim, kalɨp udmim.
Nɨhön gɨnɨg: kalöp pör hagmɨdin rö mɨɫöŋ gem kauyaŋ hagabin, nɨbi bɨ iru nöp gau nan si nan naij göm, Krais mab kros ba laŋ uma u kauaƚ mauaƚ rö mɨdpal.
Kale ram mɨnöŋ naij yaŋ u arnaböl. Hañ romaŋ kale gasɨ göp adö u nöp gasɨ nɨŋbal. Nan si nan naij gɨlö nable gɨböp pen kale bɨ gau kalɨp waiö hagpal. Nan mɨnöŋ naböŋ adö iƚ i mɨdöp nöp gasɨ nɨŋbal.
Pen ram mɨnöŋ hon u ram mɨnöŋ kumi kabö adö laŋ au mɨdöp. Kumi kabö adö laŋ au nɨbö, Bɨ nɨbi bɨ kalɨp kamɨŋ yunab u, Bɨ Kub Jisas Krais, abad mɨdpun.
Nɨpe Bɨ kƚö yabɨƚ hagö, nan gau magöŋhalö manö nɨpe nɨŋöm hain gɨnab. Bɨ Kub Jisas Krais kƚö anɨbu gö, hañ romaŋ ña hon hij gɨ lugöp gau gö, hañ romaŋ aij yabɨƚ, hañ romaŋ nɨpe ke rö lö mɨdeinabun.
